Are you ready for a new challenge in a friendly and supportive work environment where your focus on quality really matters? Your future employer is looking for enthusiastic team players to join the packing department.

As a packer, you’ll work closely with a cheerful and tight-knit team to package delicious snacks with care and precision. With your sharp eye for detail, you’ll inspect the products and ensure that only top-quality items leave the factory.

You’ll start with an average monthly salary of € 2.968,90 based on a 37,5-hour workweek. Since you’ll be working in shifts, your actual earnings may vary. The more shift hours you work, the more you’ll earn. As you gain experience and grow in the role, your salary can increase up to a maximum of €3.276,64 per month.

So what are you waiting for? Apply today! 

- You’re a true go-getter: love working with your hands and always strive for perfection? You’ll fit right in with our team
- You have experience in production or with food
- Oudkarspel is your working base: you can independently commute to our location and are ready to get started

Are you someone who enjoys going to the gym during the day or prefers doing your grocery shopping when it's nice and quiet? Then a career as a Line Operator could be exactly what you're looking for!

Working in shifts gives you a flexible schedule, making it feel like you have an extra day off every week. Sounds good, right?

As a line operator, you are responsible for ensuring the production process runs smoothly in a modern manufacturing environment. You will set up, operate, and monitor production machines and equipment to ensure production is carried out safely, efficiently, and in line with quality standards.

You will keep a close eye on the production process, identify any irregularities, and take action when needed. You'll also troubleshoot minor machine issues independently and perform first-line maintenance to keep operations running smoothly. In addition, you will carry out quality inspections and accurately record production data.

In this role, you'll work closely with colleagues from production, logistics, and the technical department. Maintaining high standards of hygiene, safety, and quality is an essential part of the job and the working environment.

- Good command of Dutch or English

jobs.description:
As a CE Truck Driver, you will transport sea containers filled with recycling materials. You will be responsible for the safe and timely delivery of your loads while representing the company professionally at customers, ports and container terminals.
Your responsibilities include:
• Transporting recycling materials in sea containers.
• Transporting loads throughout the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany.
• Collecting and delivering containers at ports, terminals and customer locations.
• Completing transport documents accurately.
• Maintaining contact with planners, terminals and customers.
• Taking good care of your truck, trailer and cargo.
• Working from Monday to Friday with overnight stays in the truck.
• Starting your trips from Heerenveen.

Functie-eisen:
- Valid CE driving licence.
• Valid Code 95.
• Valid digital driver card.
• Experience with container transport is an advantage.
• Experience driving to and from ports and container terminals is a plus.
• A responsible and independent working attitude.
• Willingness to stay overnight in the truck during the working week.
• Professional and customer-friendly attitude.
• Careful handling of vehicles, cargo and transport documents.
• You can communicate in either Dutch or English. English-speaking drivers are encouraged to apply.Apply now!
Would you like to drive modern trucks, transport recycling materials in sea containers and work for a professional transport company with clear agreements and excellent working conditions? Apply today and become part of our team!
